title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Free-Delivery Threshold: How the Order Subtotal Is Read and What It Credits
content:
**Clause.** The free-delivery test for Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery reads the whole order. When the order merchandise subtotal reaches the Threshold Delivery free-delivery threshold, a Threshold Delivery booking for that order has its base fee credited in full, with the credit given for the reason of the free-delivery threshold; and a booking for that order at a higher service level whose upgrade credit on the free threshold applies has the Threshold Delivery base delivery fee credited against its base fee. Extra item, stairs, out-of-area, Saturday, haul-away, reschedule and redelivery charges are never covered by the threshold. Cancelling items so that the subtotal falls below the threshold before dispatch reverses the threshold credit.

## The order merchandise subtotal

The order merchandise subtotal is the total of the unit prices of all purchase records that share the booking's order number and are not cancelled. Every such unit of the order counts, whether or not it travels on the delivery booking; a cancelled unit does not count.

*Hypothetical order:* units priced $1,800.00, $1,250.00 and $400.00, with the $400.00 unit cancelled. The subtotal is $1,800.00 and $1,250.00 added together, $3,050.00; the cancelled unit is left out.

## What the threshold credits

| Booking on an order whose subtotal reaches the threshold | Threshold credit |
|---|---|
| Threshold Delivery | The booking's base fee, in full |
| A higher service level whose upgrade credit on the free threshold applies | An amount equal to the Threshold Delivery base delivery fee, credited against the booking's base fee |

Charges the threshold never covers, at any service level: the extra item fee, the stairs fee, the out-of-area surcharge, the Saturday surcharge, the haul-away fee, the reschedule fee and the redelivery fee.

## Reversal

The threshold credit is reversed when items are cancelled so that the order merchandise subtotal falls below the threshold before dispatch, that is, while the booking has not yet gone out for delivery.

## Points of judgement

- **Which units does the subtotal count?** The whole order: every unit of the order number that is not cancelled.
- **Is a subtotal exactly equal to the threshold enough?** Yes. The test is met when the subtotal reaches the threshold.
- **What does a booking at a higher service level receive on a qualifying order?** Where its upgrade credit on the free threshold applies, an amount equal to the Threshold Delivery base delivery fee, set against its own base fee.
